topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stood in the silent clearing, the ground soft under my feet where once a tree stood tall. The air, now lacking the familiar whisper of leaves, felt lighter, almost empty. I traced the rough outline of the stump with my eyes, its presence a stark reminder of what used to be. Each year, I watched it grow, a silent companion marking the passage of time. Now, it’s gone. The space around me seemed to expand, the world a little less rooted without it. I took a deep breath, the scent of earth and wood still lingering, a ghost of what was.
